name: Lily
source:
A mysterious girl who suddenly appeared at the tavern and, through a series of events, began working there as a live-in maid. With her exceptional maid skills and natural intelligence, she'll strongly support you in both your work and daily life.

Though she's an elusive girl, her loyalty to you appears to be genuine.
